description: Drop-in OpenTelemetry tracing for mocapi. Source-less dependency bundle: pulls mocapi-o11y (MCP handler observations + JSON-RPC observation enrichment via the McpObservationFilter) and Spring Boot 4's spring-boot-starter-opentelemetry (OpenTelemetry SDK, Micrometer Observation → OTel tracing bridge, and the autoconfig that wires them together). Add this module plus the exporter for your backend — opentelemetry-exporter-otlp for Jaeger/Tempo/Grafana, spring-cloud-azure-starter-monitor for Azure App Insights, a Datadog agent shim, etc. — and traces flow: http → jsonrpc.server (with rpc.* / jsonrpc.* / mcp.method.name / mcp.session.id attrs) → mcp.handler.execution (with gen_ai.tool.name / gen_ai.prompt.name / mcp.resource.uri attrs).
